# 6-Month Junior Business Analyst Transition Plan for Madrid

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/briefcase.svg

You already have a strong base for BA roles: internship experience, Python, and data analysis. With **8 hours/week**, the fastest path is to pair business-facing skills with a portfolio that proves you can turn data into decisions.

## Target Role Fit and Salary Range

| Area | Your current edge | What to strengthen | Hiring signal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Data work | Python, analysis mindset | SQL, dashboards, KPI design | Can analyze business performance |
| Business analysis | Likely limited exposure | Requirements, process mapping, stakeholder communication | Can translate business needs into actions |
| Tools | Python basics | Excel, Power BI, SQL, Jira/Confluence | Ready for day-to-day BA work |
| Salary target | €30k–€38k | Positioning + proof of impact | Competitive for junior BA in Madrid |

## 6-Month Step-by-Step Career Plan

| Month | Focus | Weekly time split | Deliverable |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BA fundamentals | 3h BA concepts; 3h SQL; 2h Excel | One-page notes on BA lifecycle + SQL basics |
| 2 | Business data skills | 3h SQL; 3h Power BI; 2h Excel modeling | First dashboard with KPI definitions |
| 3 | Process and requirements | 3h user stories/process mapping; 3h stakeholder practice; 2h case studies | Requirements doc for a sample business problem |
| 4 | Portfolio project 1 | 2h SQL; 4h project work; 2h presentation | Completed project with business narrative |
| 5 | Portfolio projects 2–3 | 2h BI; 4h project work; 2h resume/LinkedIn | 3 polished portfolio pieces |
| 6 | Job search sprint | 3h applications; 3h interview prep; 2h networking | 30–50 tailored applications + interview stories |

### Weekly Routine at 8 Hours
- **2 hours:** SQL practice
- **2 hours:** Excel / Power BI
- **2 hours:** BA concepts and case studies
- **2 hours:** portfolio or job-search work

### Job Search Sequence
- Weeks 1–4: build core skills and define your BA story
- Weeks 5–10: publish 2 portfolio projects
- Weeks 11–16: add the third project and start applying seriously
- Weeks 17–24: focus on interviews, referrals, and role-specific tailoring

## Skills to Build First

| Skill | Why it matters | Priority |
|---|---|---|
| SQL | Most BA roles need querying and validation of business data | Very high |
| Excel | Still essential for analysis, reporting, and ad hoc work | Very high |
| Power BI | Helps you present insights clearly to stakeholders | Very high |
| Requirements gathering | Core BA responsibility in projects and change requests | High |
| Process mapping | Shows how work flows and where bottlenecks happen | High |
| KPI design | Lets you connect data to business outcomes | High |
| Stakeholder communication | Critical for junior BA credibility | High |
| Jira/Confluence basics | Common in agile teams and product environments | Medium |
| Python for analysis | Useful differentiator, but not the main hiring filter | Medium |

### What to Be Able to Do by Month 6
- Write clear business requirements from a vague problem
- Build a dashboard that answers a business question
- Query data with SQL to validate trends and anomalies
- Explain insights in plain business language
- Present recommendations with impact, risk, and next steps

## 3 Portfolio Projects to Prove Junior BA Readiness

### 1) Sales Funnel Performance Dashboard
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bar-chart.svg
- **Goal:** show how leads convert into revenue
- **Tools:** SQL + Power BI + Excel
- **Business value:** identifies drop-off points and conversion bottlenecks
- **Include:** KPI definitions, funnel stages, monthly trends, recommendation slide

### 2) Customer Churn Analysis and Retention Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/people.svg
- **Goal:** identify churn drivers and retention opportunities
- **Tools:** Python + SQL + Power BI
- **Business value:** shows analytical thinking plus business recommendations
- **Include:** churn segmentation, top drivers, retention actions, expected impact

### 3) Operations Process Improvement Case
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/diagram-3.svg
- **Goal:** map a broken process and propose improvements
- **Tools:** Lucidchart / Miro + Excel + Power BI
- **Business value:** demonstrates classic BA skills, not just data analysis
- **Include:** current-state flow, pain points, future-state proposal, KPI impact

### Portfolio Quality Checklist
- One clear business question per project
- Short executive summary at the top
- Clean visuals and labeled KPIs
- A recommendation section with trade-offs
- A GitHub or Notion page with screenshots and a PDF summary

## Resume Summary Tailored to Junior Business Analyst Roles

**Resume summary:**

Recent graduate in Madrid with 1 year of internship experience in data analysis and Python, combining analytical problem-solving with a strong interest in business operations and process improvement. Skilled in SQL, Excel, and data visualization, with experience turning data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. Seeking a junior business analyst role to support decision-making, optimize processes, and contribute to measurable business results.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Practice SQL] https://mode.com/sql-tutorial/
